baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed forms ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا and ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا frame the question أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ and the countercharge بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant speakers deny that they were the effective barrier. By stressing that guidance had already reached the addressees, then shifting with بَلْ to their prior condition and acquired wrongdoing, they replace a one-cause accusation with a claim of follower agency.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting grandeur supplies the socially dominant speaking pole and makes its denial interested rather than neutral.
Lack of strength, intensified by the passive form, anchors a condition imposed on the addressed group.
Turning away and causing another to turn supplies the disputed causal act.
Gentle direction toward road and truth is the access from which diversion is denied.
Lateness after a prior event makes sequence, not mere availability, central to the defense.
Coming and obtaining mark guidance as having reached the followers before the alleged obstruction.
Acquisition and causing acquisition make the closing label a claim about enacted agency, not only a fixed status.

changed_reading.before: A dominant group simply kept a powerless group from ever receiving guidance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a disputed causal chain: imposed weakness and elite diversion remain visible, but prior arrival of guidance lets the elite counterclaim that the followers also acquired and enacted culpability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالَ, the direct address لِلَّذِينَ, the interrogative أَنَحْنُ, and the corrective بَلْ form an adversarial speech act.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance negotiates a contested matter and then assumes the power to classify the other side. Its final accusation is therefore a self-interested counterjudgment inside the scene, not automatically the narrator's settled allocation of blame.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair makes the saying function as a plea in a dispute.
Passing judgment over another supplies the speech's attempt to classify the weaker party.
Rank, leadership, and elevated status give the speakers social power to make their account sound definitive.
Crime and offense provide the accusatory category imposed by that speech.

changed_reading.before: The sentence itself settles which group bears responsibility.
changed_reading.after: The sentence is the hierarchy's defensive adjudication of responsibility, so its agency claim must be heard without mistaking the claimant for the final judge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah explicitly makes speech circulate between factions and records the weakened party's counterfactual accusation. The focus utterance is thus the elite reply in a reciprocal blame proceeding.

activation_trace.role: Judgment over another anchors the focus reply as an attempted ruling on the accusers.
Repeated sayings become negotiation over the responsibility disputed in the focus.
Returning an answer or speech establishes the focus as a rejoinder rather than an isolated declaration.
Partition into parts supplies mutually accusing factions within one gathered scene.
The criminal label is the elite side's returned accusation.

structural_cues: 34:31 halts the wrongdoers before their Lord, makes each side return speech to the other, and gives the weakened party the first explicit blame claim.
34:32 preserves the same speaker labels but reverses speaker and addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal speech and the immediately preceding accusation; I infer that 34:32 is a defensive counterplea. A live alternative is that the question denies only exclusive causation, not every kind of influence.

changed_reading.before: The elite issue a standalone denial.
changed_reading.after: The elite answer a concrete charge in a reciprocal proceeding, redirecting blame after the weakened party has named them as a necessary cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates effective influence from coercive sovereignty. Following occurs despite the influencer's lack of compelling authority, while the weakened party later specifies persistent elite commands. Social pressure and follower enactment can therefore coexist.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to turn is the binary causal claim that the context makes more layered.
Following and tracking supply the followers' enacted participation in an influencer's path.
Power and governing authority, explicitly negated in the source, distinguish influence from irresistible control.
Demand and obligation supply the elite pressure that their focus denial leaves unmentioned.
Night and its darkness provide one half of the continuous temporal enclosure around the commands.
Day opening in light completes the all-cycle persistence of the pressure.
Acquired action preserves follower agency within, rather than outside, the pressure mechanism.

structural_cues: 34:20-21 pairs فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ with وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ.
34:33 answers the focus denial with مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ and إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without compelling authority and sustained human commands; I infer that causally potent pressure need not erase the follower's capacity to act. The materially live alternative is that the no-authority statement concerns Iblis and transfers to human elites only by analogy.

changed_reading.before: Either the elite blocked guidance or the followers were responsible.
changed_reading.after: The either-or is exposed as too coarse: elite command can shape and sustain refusal without becoming irresistible sovereignty, while followers remain answerable for the following they enact.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later accusation reuses diversion language against the messenger, alleging that he would turn people from ancestral worship, even as those speakers reject truth when it comes. Obstruction is therefore a contested rhetorical designation, not a self-interpreting act.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward road and truth anchors what the focus speakers allegedly blocked.
The same turning-away image is placed inside an opponent's claim that revelation obstructs inherited worship.
Truth fixed against falsehood identifies what those opponents relabel as sorcery.
Truth's coming repeats the focus sequence in which guidance had come before the dispute over diversion.

structural_cues: 34:43 combines يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُكُمْ with لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ.
The focus combines صَدَدْنَاكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَى with بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَكُم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unusually close recurrence of diversion and arrival under rival descriptions; I infer a deliberate mirror that makes naming the true route part of the conflict. The alternative is a broad thematic recurrence without a direct comment on the focus speakers.

changed_reading.before: The dispute asks only which person physically prevented access.
changed_reading.after: The dispute also concerns who may name a route guidance and name departure from inherited practice obstruction; the elite defense participates in that struggle over descriptions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence partitions accountability by each side's deeds but reserves final separation to divine judgment. The elite reply invokes the first principle when it calls the followers criminals, while speaking as though it also possessed the second.

activation_trace.role: Judgment over another anchors the elite utterance's claim to settle the case.
Crime and offense appear in a first-person responsibility formula that refuses cross-accounting.
Mutual questioning, negated for each side's deeds, separates answerability without denying either side's acts.
Intentional action assigns the addressed side its own behavioral object of accountability.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the forum in which their separate accounts meet.
Opening an enclosure by judgment supplies the reserved act of deciding between the parties.
Truth fixed to reality is the standard of the reserved judgment.

structural_cues: 34:25 says neither side is questioned about the other's crime or action.
34:26 immediately transfers gathering and truthful judgment to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies personal answerability followed by divine adjudication; I infer that 34:32 appropriates the former while rhetorically preempting the latter. A live alternative is that the elite accusation can be factually correct despite its self-serving placement.

changed_reading.before: Calling the followers criminals is either wholly true or wholly evasive.
changed_reading.after: The label borrows a valid principle of nontransferable action but weaponizes it as a premature verdict that suppresses the leaders' own contribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-exchange sequence repeatedly associates rejection with affluent notables who boast of numerical and material abundance. Yet provision is expanded and constricted from beyond them, and true greatness is located elsewhere. Elite self-magnification is thus a resource-backed social performance, not actual sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting greatness anchors the elite identity whose material basis the context exposes.
Greatness and majesty attached to God provide the contrast against human self-enlargement.
Expansive luxury that releases its possessor supplies the recurring social location of rejection.
Rivalrous numerical abundance turns possessions into a claim of superior standing and immunity.
Accumulation of wealth furnishes the material lever of that standing.
Expansion and increase relocate abundance from elite essence to provision that can be extended.
Constriction to a narrow measure makes that same resource status contingent and reversible.

structural_cues: 34:34-35 place affluent rejecters after the elite-follower exchange and give them the boast that greater wealth and children protect them.
34:22 denies false powers even an atom of ownership, while 34:37 denies that wealth and children produce nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recurring affluent rejecting type immediately after the exchange; I infer that it sharpens the social mechanism of ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا. The alternative is typological overlap rather than identity between every arrogant speaker and every affluent notable.

changed_reading.before: Those who acted great are defined only by an inward vice.
changed_reading.after: Their self-greatness is also a social structure backed by wealth, numbers, and prestige, which helps explain how they could pressure others while denying real ownership of those others' choices.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, an enabled route is followed by requested distance and fragmentation; later divine nearness contrasts with failed reaching from a far place and a final separating barrier. The focus sequence of guidance arriving, then disputed obstruction, occupies the hinge between accessible route and consequence-produced remoteness.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from a route anchors the local obstruction whose wider spatial consequence the context develops.
Gentle indication toward the road makes guidance an accessible orientation.
Arrival marks the moment when that orientation becomes available.
Going and flowing supply the earlier image of a traversable, provisioned route.
Actively making distance supplies a requested separation rather than an originally imposed absence of access.
Tearing into dispersed pieces gives requested remoteness a social and spatial consequence.
Nearness opposed to distance places the source of heard guidance close before the terminal scene.
Failure of apprehension or escape closes the earlier window of reachable response.
Reaching by extension supplies the desired act that remoteness now makes impossible.
Distance opposed to nearness names the terminal position from which belief cannot be reached.
An intervening barrier that separates two things turns the focus's disputed human blockage into a final accomplished separation.

structural_cues: 34:18 offers measured, safe travel; 34:19 requests distance, records self-wrong, and ends in dispersion.
34:50-54 move from a near Lord through no escape and unreachable belief from afar to an actual barrier between people and what they desire.
34:53 adds that prior rejection and conjectural throwing came from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated route, nearness, remoteness, reaching, and barrier images; I infer a surah-level topology in which refused access becomes irreversible distance. The alternative is that the Saba route and final seizure are analogical episodes rather than one continuous causal history.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only a local argument about who blocked whom in the past.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a hinge in a larger access pattern: a route was supplied and guidance arrived, remoteness was produced through response, and what was once reachable finally stands behind a real barrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exhortation dismantles crowd hierarchy by asking hearers to rise in pairs and alone, then deliberate. Being made weak names a social relation, but does not erase the capacity to step outside collective pressure and think.

activation_trace.role: Lack of strength under an imposed passive form anchors the socially diminished group.
Rising with resolve supplies recoverable action rather than permanent incapacity.
Joining one to one reduces the crowd to a small relational unit where elite consensus can be tested.
The solitary individual supplies deliberation outside leader-follower mass alignment.
The heart's repeated turning over a matter supplies the cognitive act by which inherited pressure can be reexamined.

structural_cues: 34:46 follows the collective blame and affluent-rejection scenes with a command to stand for God in pairs and individually, then think.
The focus calls the subordinate group made weak rather than depicting them as constitutionally without agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later pair-and-solitary deliberative procedure; I infer that it answers the mechanism of group capture exposed around the focus. The alternative is a general apologetic exhortation not specifically aimed at elite-follower dependence.

changed_reading.before: Imposed weakness and personal responsibility are incompatible descriptions.
changed_reading.after: They describe different levels: hierarchy can diminish people, while pairwise and solitary reflection shows a remaining capacity to recover judgment and therefore a basis for answerability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because one root inventory moves from lack of strength in the focus to increase by a like amount in 34:37. It remains valid as a same-root polarity that unsettles the finality of the social label, but downstream prose must not translate ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا as multiplication or claim that the doubled reward is promised specifically to this group.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا carries the ض ع ف root whose other packet branch is activated by جَزَاءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ.

activation_trace.role: Weakness contrary to strength supplies the group's imposed present diminishment.
Increase by a matching amount supplies a latent reversal from social reduction to multiplied recompense.

changed_reading.before: The root label fixes the addressed group entirely within deficit.
changed_reading.after: The same root field carries a contained reversal: imposed diminishment is not semantically terminal, because the surah later activates multiplication in recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it combines remote material branches: a road to water, a mountain barrier, and pooled water around a fortification. It remains anchored in صَدَدْنَاكُمْ, ٱلْهُدَى, and جَاءَكُمْ as an access analogy, but downstream prose must label it material imagery and never substitute those remote senses for the ayah's ordinary syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins diversion, path-guidance, and arrival in one causal question.

activation_trace.role: A road leading to water supplies the material image of access to a sustaining resource.
A mountain acting as a barrier supplies the infrastructure of intercepted access.
Guidance as direction to a road keeps the material analogy attached to the focus construction.
Water gathered in a depression or around a fortification supplies the branch-distant image of a resource present yet spatially controlled.

changed_reading.before: Obstruction is an abstract act of persuasion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the accusation pictures guidance as access infrastructure: a sustaining route has arrived, and the dispute is whether elites installed the barrier controlling approach to it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping supplied for the focus root ق و ل. It remains anchored as an inspectable split-root activation that describes what the utterance does rhetorically, but downstream prose must never gloss قَالَ as becoming little or present the image as etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ introduces a defense that narrows the speakers' acknowledged causal share.

activation_trace.role: Scantness and smallness supply the exploratory image of speech shrinking admitted responsibility.
Judgment over another supplies the complementary move: the speakers minimize their share by enlarging the other's blame.

changed_reading.before: The elite utterance only reports their view of causation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained rhetorical activation, the saying performs minimization: it shrinks the speakers' causal share while issuing a judgment that expands the followers' blame.

strongest_changes: The adjacent returned-speech scene makes 34:32 an elite counterplea rather than a narratorial settlement.
Following without coercive authority, followed by explicit commands across night and day, produces layered causation in which elite influence and follower accountability coexist.
The mirrored obstruction claim in 34:43 and the final near-far-barrier sequence turn diversion into both a struggle over naming the true route and a trajectory toward irreversible failed access.
The affluent-rejecter sequence gives self-magnification a material social mechanism while denying it real sovereignty.
summary.what_was_special: The packet preserved opposed mechanisms instead of forcing a verdict: imposed weakness versus recoverable agency, social pressure versus coercion, personal answerability versus premature elite judgment, and an accessible route that becomes remoteness. Same-root and split-root outliers also exposed multiplication inside ض ع ف and rhetorical minimization through the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from Iblis's lack of سلطان to human elite influence is a strong analogy but not an explicit identity.
The affluent rejecters likely sharpen the type ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا, but the packet does not require every member of the two groups to be identical.
The route-to-water, pooled-water, multiplication, and split-root minimization images require explicit qualification to avoid lexical overreach.
